meta.title: Welcome — OpenScreenShot
meta.description: OpenScreenShot is installed. Click the toolbar icon to take your first full-page capture, right here on this page.

headline: You're in. Click the icon.
body: OpenScreenShot captures the whole page in one click. No account. Nothing leaves this machine. Try it on this page right now.
primary: Click the OpenScreenShot icon in the toolbar.
pinSub: Click the 🧩 up there, then the 📌 next to OpenScreenShot.
bandBody: Long pages scroll and stitch into one image. Sticky headers appear once, nested scrollers are handled, and the footer makes it in.
endBody: If your capture reached this band, it got the whole page. That is the point.
